Hello,

You're right to question it, and I'm sorry. October 30 was a mistake on my part, since that date has already passed. Your order shows a ship date of November 14, 2026 for the Harlo B30. That matches the notice we sent you by email and text on September 15.

To be straight with you, part of the first B30 shipment has arrived at our US warehouse and is being checked in. The next shipments are due there in late November. I've asked a colleague to confirm which shipment your unit is in and whether November 14 still holds. Someone will pick this up today and reply to you in this thread.

Your Power K. and Miner D. ship in the same box as the B30. We'll email you tracking the day it ships. You can follow the B30 shipments on their way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Best regards,
Sarah
